export: Lossless JSON value export; original bytes retained.

review.scope: Independent bounded review of four current changed source/test files and focused R1/R2 repair probes; no product mutation, provider/network/model calls, commit or deployment.

repaired_findings.result: Repeated message-1 completion at 10 and 90 retains first_text=last_text=10, both before and after acknowledgement; unrelated turn cannot poison dedupe; terminal=100 freezes later text.
No-text first_response=90 after terminal=40 rejected; equal 40 accepted; early event before acknowledgement retained.

javascript_probes.boundaries: Same-text deltas and distinct IDs preserved; missing/invalid IDs ignored; empty identified message is response only; 256 unique completions accepted, duplicates/unrelated IDs do not overflow; 257th unique clears four event marks and subsequent events stay unknown; original callbacks and both observer wrappers restored; exactly two mock RPC calls per fixture.

python_probes.boundaries: Reversed/equal/order bounds, no-text, text, early acknowledgement ordering, unknown marks, duplicate RPC sentinel and boolean marks.

independent_validation.process_terminal: All three foreground processes returned exit_code=0, no session_id or background worker; no pending processes spawned by reviewer.

method_learning.applied: Recalled verified await-terminal-observers, bind-consumer-release, reconstruct-worker-outcomes, review-context-and-source-evidence. Bound review to exact current bytes and actual foreground terminals; prior stale live installation cannot inherit approval.

limitations: No live installation script imported or executed; stale preregistered installation remains inadmissible.
No actual provider latency or full business acceptance established.
Python full suite, Ruff and mypy are root-reported checks; reviewer independently ran focused Python probes and 30 JS tests.
Scoped pass does not authorize production cutover, CI/main delivery or issue closure.
review.cleanup: Only assigned report and probe directory written. Probe sources and process-results retained as reproducible review evidence; no temporary installations, branches, worktrees or background processes created.
